entries.title: Luke 24:1
segments: ¶Now on the first [day] of the week, very early in the morning, they, and certain [other women] with them, came to the tomb bringing the spices which they had prepared.

entries.title: Luke 24:2
segments: But they found the stone rolled away from the tomb.

entries.title: Luke 24:3
segments: Then they went in and did not find the body of the Lord Jesus.

entries.title: Luke 24:4
segments: And it happened, as they were greatly perplexed about this, that behold, two men stood by them in shining garments.

entries.title: Luke 24:5
segments: Then, as they were afraid and bowed [their] faces to the earth, they said to them, "Why do you seek the living among the dead?

entries.title: Luke 24:6
segments: "He is not here, but is risen! Remember how He spoke to you when He was still in Galilee,

entries.title: Luke 24:7
segments: "saying, 'The Son of Man must be delivered into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again.'"

entries.title: Luke 24:8
segments: And they remembered His words.

entries.title: Luke 24:9
segments: Then they returned from the tomb and told all these things to the eleven and to all the rest.

entries.title: Luke 24:10
segments: It was Mary Magdalene, Joanna, Mary [the mother] of James, and the other [women] with them, who told these things to the apostles.

entries.title: Luke 24:11
segments: And their words seemed to them like idle tales, and they did not believe them.

entries.title: Luke 24:12
segments: But Peter arose and ran to the tomb; and stooping down, he saw the linen cloths lying by themselves; and he departed, marveling to himself at what had happened.

entries.title: Luke 24:13
segments: ¶Now behold, two of them were traveling that same day to a village called Emmaus, which was seven miles from Jerusalem.

entries.title: Luke 24:14
segments: And they talked together of all these things which had happened.

entries.title: Luke 24:15
segments: So it was, while they conversed and reasoned, that Jesus Himself drew near and went with them.

entries.title: Luke 24:16
segments: But their eyes were restrained, so that they did not know Him.

entries.title: Luke 24:17
segments: And He said to them, "What kind of conversation [is] this that you have with one another as you walk and are sad?"

entries.title: Luke 24:18
segments: Then the one whose name was Cleopas answered and said to Him, "Are You the only stranger in Jerusalem, and have You not known the things which happened there in these days?"

entries.title: Luke 24:19
segments: And He said to them, "What things?" So they said to Him, "The things concerning Jesus of Nazareth, who was a Prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people,

entries.title: Luke 24:20
segments: "and how the chief priests and our rulers delivered Him to be condemned to death, and crucified Him.

entries.title: Luke 24:21
segments: "But we were hoping that it was He who was going to redeem Israel. Indeed, besides all this, today is the third day since these things happened.

entries.title: Luke 24:22
segments: "Yes, and certain women of our company, who arrived at the tomb early, astonished us.

entries.title: Luke 24:23
segments: "When they did not find His body, they came saying that they had also seen a vision of angels who said He was alive.

entries.title: Luke 24:24
segments: "And certain of those [who were] with us went to the tomb and found [it] just as the women had said; but Him they did not see."

entries.title: Luke 24:25
segments: Then He said to them, "O foolish ones, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!

entries.title: Luke 24:26
segments: "Ought not the Christ to have suffered these things and to enter into His glory?"

entries.title: Luke 24:27
segments: And beginning at Moses and all the Prophets, He expounded to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning Himself.

entries.title: Luke 24:28
segments: Then they drew near to the village where they were going, and He indicated that He would have gone farther.

entries.title: Luke 24:29
segments: But they constrained Him, saying, "Abide with us, for it is toward evening, and the day is far spent." And He went in to stay with them.

entries.title: Luke 24:30
segments: Now it came to pass, as He sat at the table with them, that He took bread, blessed and broke [it], and gave it to them.

entries.title: Luke 24:31
segments: Then their eyes were opened and they knew Him; and He vanished from their sight.

entries.title: Luke 24:32
segments: And they said to one another, "Did not our heart burn within us while He talked with us on the road, and while He opened the Scriptures to us?"

entries.title: Luke 24:33
segments: So they rose up that very hour and returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven and those [who were] with them gathered together,

entries.title: Luke 24:34
segments: saying, "The Lord is risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon!"

entries.title: Luke 24:35
segments: And they told about the things [that had happened] on the road, and how He was known to them in the breaking of bread.

entries.title: Luke 24:36
segments: ¶Now as they said these things, Jesus Himself stood in the midst of them, and said to them, "Peace to you."

entries.title: Luke 24:37
segments: But they were terrified and frightened, and supposed they had seen a spirit.

entries.title: Luke 24:38
segments: And He said to them, "Why are you troubled? And why do doubts arise in your hearts?

entries.title: Luke 24:39
segments: "Behold My hands and My feet, that it is I Myself. Handle Me and see, for a spirit does not have flesh and bones as you see I have."

entries.title: Luke 24:40
segments: When He had said this, He showed them His hands and His feet.

entries.title: Luke 24:41
segments: But while they still did not believe for joy, and marveled, He said to them, "Have you any food here?"

entries.title: Luke 24:42
segments: So they gave Him a piece of a broiled fish and some honeycomb.

entries.title: Luke 24:43
segments: And He took [it] and ate in their presence.

entries.title: Luke 24:44
segments: Then He said to them, "These [are] the words which I spoke to you while I was still with you, that all things must be fulfilled which were written in the Law of Moses and [the]  Prophets and [the] Psalms concerning Me."

entries.title: Luke 24:45
segments: And He opened their understanding, that they might comprehend the Scriptures.

entries.title: Luke 24:46
segments: Then He said to them, "Thus it is written, and thus it was necessary for the Christ to suffer and to rise from the dead the third day,

entries.title: Luke 24:47
segments: "and that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in His name to all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.

entries.title: Luke 24:48
segments: "And you are witnesses of these things.

entries.title: Luke 24:49
segments: "Behold, I send the Promise of My Father upon you; but tarry in the city of Jerusalem until you are endued with power from on high."

entries.title: Luke 24:50
segments: ¶And He led them out as far as Bethany, and He lifted up His hands and blessed them.

entries.title: Luke 24:51
segments: Now it came to pass, while He blessed them, that He was parted from them and carried up into heaven.

entries.title: Luke 24:52
segments: And they worshiped Him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy,

entries.title: Luke 24:53
segments: and were continually in the temple praising and blessing God. Amen.
